search.ranking_note: Lexicographic minimum within this finite candidate set, prioritizing fewer circuits then smaller cross-section then lower fixed source setpoint. NOT global least-cost planning, material minimum, or proof against all other reinforcement types.
search.alternative_note: Predeclared engineering sensitivity, not a manufacturer grouping factor or statistical confidence bound. Same candidate family; reported separately from nominal minimum.

parameter_provenance.basis: Baran-Wu/MATPOWER case33bw topology, physical series R/X and background P/Q, via installed pandapower3.5.6. All corridors except1-2 are preserved.

Enhanced33 literature supports voltage control within0.95-1.05pu. Search1.00-1.05 in0.005pu increments is our finite research choice, not a reproduced OLTC tap specification. Fixed selected secondary-bus voltage; no explicit transformer, tap controller, delay or wear.

Current Nexans/La Triveneta Cavi product web pages: RG16H1M20, Cu,12/20(24)kV, AC resistance at90C, trefoil X at50Hz, capacitance, buried20C trefoil continuous current. Each parallel circuit means3 single-core phase cables, not one single-phase wire.

Retain60Hz of the packaged case. X60=X50*60/50 assuming constant inductance; use catalog capacitance at60Hz in pi model. R90C is held as an approximate equivalent; sensitivity+10%. Catalog ampacity is a benchmark proxy, NOT certified60Hz ampacity; sensitivity-10%/-20% does not replace engineering calculation.

Older2021 manufacturer PDF gives larger ampacities for the same labels than current product pages. Use the explicitly linked current web-page values consistently; do not mix old ampacity with new entries. This unresolved version/installation difference is another reason these are research equivalent parameters, not procurement specifications.

1km is an explicit hypothetical route, not inferred from pandapower's unit-length representation. Sensitivity0.5/1/2/3km. Equal circuits with symmetric current sharing; no inter-circuit thermal/magnetic coupling model. R_eq=R*L/n, X_eq=X*L/n, C_eq=C*L*n; I_limit=n*I_catalog*factor.

parameter_provenance.parameter: unchanged supply and other current limits
parameter_provenance.basis: 40MVA head planning limit and600A other-line planning limits retained from earlier screen, not IEEE source equipment ratings. Sensitivity30/35/40MVA and300/450/600/750A. No transformer losses added because a new transformer is not modeled and facility transformer losses are already in PCC load.

AIDC min/mean/peak at full original background; peak plus simultaneous rated ESS/TES charge as an instantaneous electrical envelope; min minus rated discharge; AIDCoff at background1/0.5/0.1/0. Not a guaranteed continuous maximum-charge schedule.
